trajectory.final_answer: Finding: the program accepts a customer identifier and elapsed days at KYCSYNC2.cbl:21-22 and only labels the record OVERDUE or INSLA at KYCSYNC2.cbl:27-30. No update of KYC records in the Central KYC Records Registry is present, so the required update rule is missing.

regulation_clause.text: Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every two years for high-risk, once every eight years for medium-risk, and once every ten years for low-risk customers, from the date of account opening or last KYC updation.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 42(1) requires periodic KYC updation at least every 2 years (high risk), 8 years (medium risk), and 10 years (low risk). 2000-CHECK-DUE's EVALUATE correctly applies >=2 for 'H' (lines 26-29), >=8 for 'M' (lines 30-33), and >=10 for any other rating including 'L' (lines 34-37), matching all three composite leaves and the at-least semantics.

The paragraph's own comment '* ADD MORE VALIDATIONS HERE' (line 377) marks the natural insertion point for such a check.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 12(5) conditions breach on explicit consent (breach -> consent). 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT rejects any transaction that would exceed ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT (lines 403-411) and the main loop never posts a failed transaction (lines 211-216), making the antecedent always false and the conditional vacuously satisfied, per the adjudication note.

provenance.annotator_notes: Adjudicated 2026-07-27: Pass 1 read the blanket rejection of over-limit transactions as conformant (D7); Pass 2 read the absent consent-capture path as a missing rule (D2). Resolved on the clause's own grammar: 'shall not be breached... without explicit consent' is the conditional breach -> consent. CBTRN02C's 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT makes the antecedent always false (no transaction that would breach the limit is ever posted, lines 403-411 reject it via WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON=102, and the main loop never posts a failed transaction, lines 211-216), which satisfies the conditional regardless of whether a distinct consent mechanism exists. The cited text conditions breach on consent; it does not separately mandate that a consent-gated override path be offered. Pass 1's reading is accepted.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 23(6) requires interest be levied only on the outstanding amount, adjusted for payments, refunds, and reversed transactions. CBACT04C's 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST computes interest directly from TRAN-CAT-BAL (lines 464-466). Per adjudication cross-reference to CBTRN02C (the program maintaining TCATBAL-FILE), TRAN-CAT-BAL is accumulated via signed ADD DALYTRAN-AMT (2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC, line 527), and DALYTRAN-AMT is confirmed signed by the adjacent IF DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0 branch in 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC (line 548). Signed accumulation nets offsetting payment/refund/reversal entries into the category balance by construction, satisfying the clause's adjustment requirement.

provenance.annotator_notes: Adjudicated 2026-07-28: both passes independently reached needs_adjudication, citing insufficient evidence from CBACT04C alone about whether TRAN-CAT-BAL already nets payments, refunds, and reversed transactions. Cross-referencing the sibling real-curated candidate CBTRN02C in the same evidence bundle (the program that posts to TCATBAL-FILE) resolves this: CBTRN02C's 2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC accumulates the category balance via 'ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL', and 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC's 'IF DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0' branch (immediately following) confirms DALYTRAN-AMT is a signed amount -- positive for debits/purchases, negative for credits/payments/refunds/reversals. Signed accumulation means TRAN-CAT-BAL already reflects netting of offsetting entries by construction, before CBACT04C ever reads it. This is decisive primary evidence within the same bundle, not external or historical evidence, so the needs_adjudication gap is resolved rather than defaulted to exclude.
